individual-data-points.explanation: Stacked area/bar plot showing median state frequency per Pol II ChIP-seq bin across a continuum of bins; this is a distributional/composition summary over many bins (akin to a line/area plot) rather than a simple bar chart of a few group means, so individual points are not required.
Single-molecule stack displays every individual molecule's raw methylation data (each row is one molecule), so it already shows the underlying individual data points.
